text: Hey! What can I get ya?
Hey, I'm Jake. What's your name?
Nice to meet you! Where are you from?
Oh, cool! What brings you here?
Awesome. So how do you like it so far?
Nice! Well, it was good meeting you.
Hey, you okay? You look kinda lost.
Oh, it's just two blocks down that way, on the left.
No problem. Have a good one!
Hi there! You ready to order?
Yeah, can I get a burger?
Sure. Fries or salad on the side?
Got it. I'll be right back with that.
Can I get you anything else?
Great. Can I get your last name?
Perfect. Okay, you're all set. You're in room five twelve.
Yep, the password's on your key card.
Hey! Can I help you find anything?
Actually, do you have this in a medium?
Let me check... Yep, here you go.
Thanks! Where can I try it on?
Fitting rooms are right over there.
It fits great. I'll take it!
Of course. Just tap it right here.
Hey! What are you up to this weekend?
Wanna go see a movie on Saturday?
Cool! What time works for you?
Hi, how can I help you?
Oh, sorry. How long have you had it?
Okay. Try these. Take two every six hours.
Two every six hours. Got it.
Will do. How much is it?
Not bad. I just stayed home and chilled.
Nice. I went to the beach.
Oh, fun! Hey, you want some coffee?
Doing good, thanks. Did you find everything okay?
Okay, your total is twelve forty.
Sure. You're all set. Have a good one!
Oh, good! You were out cold.
You… okay? Did you hit your head or something?
“Me is”? Wow. Okay, take it easy, buddy.
You… no know? Hmm, you must be really tired.
Well, I'll call you Newbie. Nice to meet you, Newbie!
Me too… what? Haha, you're funny.
Huh. A real mystery, aren't you?
From… no? Is that a place?
Oh, the door's locked. My bad!
Can I get the key, please?
Whoa. Okay… “please” is free, you know. That's two coins for the attitude.
Key… me… give? I don't get it. Hmm, there's a spare key in there somewhere.
You found it? Nice! Come on down.
Okay, Newbie. That's five coins for the room.
Can I get some coffee and bread?
I don't like coffee. Can I get some water?
No coffee? Okay, water it is.
You… like no coffee? Like, you don't like it?
Wow. Somebody's grumpy in the morning. Fine. That's one extra coin.
And since you asked so nicely, breakfast is on the house!
Whoa, your bracelet! I've seen that symbol before… Here, take this. Go to the Guild and ask for Marcus.
Be careful out there. Shinar's a big city.
Fresh apples! Apples here! Hey, you! You hungry?
Come on! Just look at these apples!
You… have hungry? Like a pet? Haha.
They're two coins each. How many do you want?
Can I get two apples, please?
Just one? Okay, that's two coins.
Two… apple? You mean apples, right?
Thanks, buddy! Hey, you look cold. Go see Mei over there. She sells cloaks.
Hi there! Looking for a cloak?
How much… it is? Oh, you mean the price?
I've got red, blue and green. Which one do you like?
The one… blue? You mean the blue one?
Oh wait, I've got a yellow one too. Can you grab the yellow one for me? It's on the left.
Thanks! Anyway, your cloak is twelve coins.
Hmm… can I get it for ten?
Ha! You're good. Okay, ten. Deal!
Crazy? Fine. Then it's thirteen for you.
Looks great on you! Have a good one!
Me… also? Haha, you mean “you too”.
Can I get it for ten?
Stop right there. What do you want?
You… look for Marcus? Right now? Like, with your eyes?
Excuse me? Nobody talks to me like that. Wait over there.
Okay. Let's try that again. Be nice this time.
Sorry. Can I see Marcus, please?
Marcus is busy. He doesn't see just anybody. Name?
You don't remember? Great. Just great.
Your name… are? How many names do you have?
You don't know much, do you?
You have… twenty years? Where do you keep them?
And what do you do? Do you have a job?
No, I don't have a job.
Not yet. I'm looking for work.
You… not have job? Okay, okay. I get it.
Wait… that bracelet. Show me your hand.
By the gods… Come in. Now.
Nothing's wrong. Just… come in. Now.
Fine, fine. Calm down. Just come in.
So you're the one Rosie told me about. I'm Marcus. I run the Guild.
Here, people work. They carry boxes, they deliver letters, they help the city. Every day.
Tell me. What does Rosie do?
That's right. Best bread in Shinar.
She… run? Is she running away?
Good. And Tobias? The apple guy?
You learn fast. Okay, Newbie, you want a job? Be here at eight. Don't be late. And always say please.
Got it. I'll be here at eight.
Okay, I am here at eight tomorrow.
You are here… tomorrow? Today? Now? Ha.
One more thing. That bracelet… I saw one just like it, years ago. On the wrist of the Queen's advisor.
Get some rest. Tomorrow, your first job.
Good morning, Newbie! Time to get up!
Good morning! What time is it?
Good morning! What hour is it?
What… hour? Oh, you mean the time?
It's seven o'clock. You start work at eight, right?
Good. Breakfast is at half past seven!
In eight? In eight days? Haha.
Newbie, this is my daughter, Lena. She's the cook here.
Hi! Nice to meet you. Do you usually eat breakfast?
And what time do you usually get up?
I usually get up at seven.
I usually getting up at seven.
Here, look at the calendar. Today is Monday. The Guild is closed on Sundays.
Newbie! It's quarter to eight! Hurry!
Oh no! Thanks, see you later!
Oh no! Bye, see you tonight!
Good morning. I'm Iris. I write everybody's details in the Guild book. What's your name?
I live at the Sleepy Fox, on King Street.
I am live at the Sleepy Fox.
Every day, from Monday to Saturday.
Great. Work starts at eight and finishes at five. Lunch is at twelve.
Newbie! You're on time. Good. Tell me about your day. What do you do in the morning?
I get up at seven, I have breakfast and I go to work.
I gets up at seven and I goes to work.
I gets? I goes? Only he and she get the -s, Newbie.
From tomorrow, you deliver letters. Every morning. Don't be late!
I live at the Sleepy Fox.
I work from Monday to Friday.
Three letters today. One for the bakery, one for the bank, and one for number forty-two, Fish Street.
Hey! You look lost. Need some help?
Bakery… where? Haha, ask me properly!
I'm Pip. Go straight and turn left. The bakery is next to the bank.
So, which one is the bakery? Remember: it's next to the bank!
The bakery is next to the bank!
That's the bank. Next to it!
Look, here's Fish Street. Find number forty-two!
Wait, nobody's home. But look, there's a note on the door: “Gone to the harbour.”
Is there a harbour near here? Yes, there is! Are there many ships? Yes, there are! Your turn. Are there any shops on Fish Street?
Right! A fish shop and a shoe shop.
There is two? Two is more than one, buddy!
It has? Who has? Haha. Try “there are”.
To the harbour: go back to the well and turn right. Then go straight. Don't go left, it's a dead end!
Got it! Turn right at the well and go straight.
Got it! Turn left at the well.
Left? No! Left is the dead end. Listen again.
Hey… can I have a coin? For the help?
Sure! Here you go. Thanks, Pip!
Sorry, I don't have any coins.
Is there a bank near here?
Ahoy! You've got a letter? For me? I'm Captain Ola!
Yes, here you go. It's for you.
Thank you! Oh, it's from my brother!
Is for me? What is? Haha.
Look! That ship is my brother's ship. Her name is the Gull.
Quick question, sailor! Whose ship is that? Mine or my brother's?
Right! I've got a small boat. He's got a big ship. Haha!
Of my brother? Hmm, say it like a sailor!
I love my family. Look, I've got a picture.
Can you find my daughter? She's got red hair.
That's my mother. She's old, not red!
And you? Have you got any brothers or sisters?
I've got a sister, I think.
Got sister? A sister? Two sisters?
Okay, tell me. What does she look like?
She's tall. She's got long black hair.
She's got brown eyes and a big smile.
Hair long black? Like a long black rope? Haha.
He's tall. His hair is black.
He? His? I thought it was your sister!
Wait… I know a girl like that! Long black hair, a big smile… and a bracelet like yours! She was on my brother's ship. Last year.
I don't know. To the capital, I think.
Where she is? Ask me again, sailor!
Here, take this. It's my old compass. Your sister's got the same eyes as you, you know.
Have you got any brothers or sisters?
Welcome back! Dinner time! Here's the menu.
I'd like the fish soup, please.
I'd like the chicken and rice, please.
I would like of the soup.
Like of the soup? Hmm. Just “the soup”.
Can I have some orange juice?
A water? One water? Like, one drop? Haha.
Oh, Lena! There isn't any bread today. Sorry, Newbie!
That's okay. Are there any eggs?
Yes, there are! Two eggs for you.
No problem. Is there any cheese?
That's okay. Is there any eggs?
Is there eggs? One egg or many eggs?
Do you eat meat? I've got some good sausages.
No, thanks. I don't eat meat.
No problem! More soup for you.
I love cooking, but I hate washing the dishes! What do you like doing in your free time?
Really? Then you wash the dishes! Haha.
Tonight's dinner is eight coins, Newbie.
Sure. Can I have the bill, please?
Sure. Can I have the account?
The account? Like at the bank? Haha.
Are you okay? You look happy… and sad.
I'm okay. Thanks for the cake!
Can I have the bill, please?
Hi again! The Festival of the Tower is on the fifteenth of May. You need nice clothes!
It's on the fifteenth of May.
It's in the fifteen of May.
In the fifteen? Almost! Try again.
Look at these boots! Do you like them?
Yes, I like them! Can I try them on?
This boots? One boot or two?
They're too big. Have you got a smaller size?
They're too small. Have you got a bigger size?
Very much big? Haha, say “too big”!
Perfect! Can you pass me that hat, please? The one with the flower.
The boots are nine coins and the shirt is six. That's fifteen.
So, when's your birthday? Maybe I can give you a gift!
I don't remember. But my sister's birthday is in May!
My sister's birthday is on May.
I love May. Spring is my favourite season. What's your favourite season?
I love spring. It's warm and sunny.
I like winter. I love the cold!
I like summer. I love the sea.
Is this your bag? Over here, by my stall?
No, that's my bag, over there.
Oh! Okay. See you at the festival!
No, this is my bag, over there.
This… over there? Far away is “that”.
The festival is on the fifteenth of May.
Have you got a smaller size?
My sister's birthday is in May.
Newbie! Newbie! What's the weather like? Look at me! Haha!
Yeah! And I'm all wet! Haha.
Listen! Marcus is looking for you. He's waiting at the old temple. Come on, I know the way!
Shh. Quiet. Ana is reading the old stones.
Welcome. I'm Ana. I look after the temple. What are you doing here?
You look for… every day? Or now?
Marcus says your bracelet is special. Look at these letters on the altar. Can you read them?
You can read it? Nobody can read it!
No, I can't read it. Sorry.
Look again. Your bracelet is glowing…
Tell me about you, Newbie. Can you swim? Can you ride a horse?
I can swim, but I can't ride a horse.
I can ride a horse, but I can't swim.
Can't swim? Stay away from the harbour, then!
Do you trust Marcus? Do you like him?
Yes, I like him. He's kind.
Newbie! What's he doing? Where's he going?
He run? Now! Quick, say it right!
Don't worry. We can find him. Come to the Fox tomorrow. Marcus wants to talk to you.
Newbie! Where were you last night? You were out all night!
I was at the temple with Ana and Bram.
The old temple? At night? Are you crazy?
Bram told me about the thief. Was he tall or short?
He was tall. His cloak was black.
He was short. His hair was grey.
Me too, and I wasn't even there!
No, I wasn't. I was angry!
And where were Ana and Bram?
They were at the harbour with me.
Newbie… I know that bracelet now. It was your mother's. Your mother was the Queen's advisor.
My mother? Really? Where is she now?
My mother? Was she a good person?
She was the best. Kind and very smart.
Your family was very important. And your sister… she wasn't on a ship by chance. She was looking for the Tower crystals.
Newbie? You're crying. What is it?
I remember now. My name is Ari.
Ari! How do you spell that?
A-R-I. Ari! Nice to meet you, Ari!
Ari, your sister went to the capital. The Guild has a job there, a long trip. Are you ready?
Good. We leave after the festival.
We were strangers a week ago. Now you're family, Ari. Come back soon!
Thanks for everything, Rosie. I'll be back!
